name: minesweeperr
summary:
Minesweeperr brings the classic logic-based puzzle game to life with immersive themes and effects. Your mission is to uncover all the safe tiles while avoiding hidden mines. Revealing a tile may show a blank space or a number indicating the mines hidden in adjacent tiles. Use these clues to strategically deduce mine locations and mark them with flags. But beware—a single misstep can end the game! Successfully clear all the safe tiles to claim victory.
